name: web/JSONP callback reflection
description: [medium] Proves JSONP callback reflection (CWE-346): ?callback=x9QcB is reflected RAW as x9QcB({...}) with a JavaScript content-type = arbitrary script execution in the API's origin and cross-origin data theft on legacy endpoints. Keywords: jsonp callback reflection cross-origin cwe-346 javascript content-type. ctrl: benign callback is stripped/sanitized -> token absent -> not falsified. base_url = API host; skill rides /api/user (copy for other JSONP endpoints).
